gallery.description: A U.S. Army Air Forces Martin B-26B-55-MA Marauder (s/n 42-96142). The aircraft was assigned to the 596th Bombardment Squadron, 397th Bombardment Group, 98th Bombardment Wing, 9th Bomber Command, 9th Air Force in Europe. "X2-A" was named "Dee-Feater" and carries numerous mission markers, and D-Day invasion stripes. The 397th BG was stationed starting 15 April 1944 at Rivenhall, Essex (UK), and moved to Hurn, Hampshire, on 4 August 1944. On 30th August 1944 the Group was relocated to France.

gallery.title: File:100811-D-7203C-008 (4886099878).jpg
gallery.description: U.S. Defense Secretary Robert M. Gates addresses the audience during an assumption of command ceremony on MacDill Air Force Base, Fla., Aug. 11, 2010. During the ceremony, Marine Lt. Gen. John Allen, outgoing acting commander, second from left, handed over command of U.S. Central Command to Marine Gen. James N. Mattis, second from right. Marine Gen. James Cartwright, vice chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, also spoke during the ceremoy. DoD photo by Cherie Cullen

gallery.title: File:100120-F-7713A-313 (4310107667).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: A U.S. Airman with the 6th Medical Group's mobile aeromedical staging facility team prepares to depart MacDill Air Force Base, Fla., Jan. 20, 2010, aboard a C-130 Hercules aircraft for humanitarian relief operations in Haiti. The 13-Airman team consists of nurses, aeromedical technicians and administrators who will provide medical treatment to victims of the massive earthquake which occured in Haiti Jan. 12, 2010. (U.S. Air Force photo by Senior Airman Rylan Albright/Released)
